strands.name: Pressure
strands.description: Winning the ball back and denying space.

strands.name: Game flow
strands.description: Rules, phases of play, and how matches change over time.

concepts.name: Possession
concepts.objective: Tell which team has the ball and notice when it changes hands.

concepts.name: Tackles and turnovers
concepts.objective: Recognize how a team wins the ball back: tackles, interceptions, and loose balls.

concepts.name: Shots and goals
concepts.objective: Recognize shots, shots on target, saves, and goals.

concepts.name: Restarts
concepts.objective: Say which restart comes next, and for which team, when the ball goes out of play.

concepts.name: Offside
concepts.objective: Tell whether an attacker is offside when the ball is played to them.

concepts.name: Fouls and cards
concepts.objective: Say what a foul gives, and to whom, why a player is booked, and when the referee plays advantage.

concepts.name: Passing and pass difficulty
concepts.objective: Distinguish pass types (short, long, forward, backward) and judge how difficult a pass was.

concepts.name: Pressing
concepts.objective: Recognize when a team is pressing: closing down the ball carrier to force a mistake or win it back.

concepts.name: Chance quality
concepts.objective: Judge whether a chance was good or poor from shot location, angle, and the build-up.

concepts.name: Transitions and counterattacks
concepts.objective: Recognize the moment after a turnover, when both teams are briefly out of shape, and spot a counterattack.

concepts.name: Phase of play
concepts.objective: Tell whether play is settled, in transition, or stopped, and why that changes what teams try to do.

concepts.name: Line-breaking passes
concepts.objective: Spot passes that cut through a defensive line and explain why they create danger.

concepts.name: Counter-pressing
concepts.objective: Recognize a counter-press: winning the ball straight back after losing it, before the opponent can organize.

concepts.name: Pressing triggers and block height
concepts.objective: Predict when a team will press (its triggers) and describe how high or deep it defends.

concepts.name: Expected goals (xG)
concepts.objective: Explain xG as the probability a shot becomes a goal, and use it to compare chances.

concepts.name: Game state
concepts.objective: Explain how the score and the clock change how teams play.

concepts.name: Expected threat (xT) and possession value
concepts.objective: Use xT to value actions that do not end in shots, and explain its limits.

concepts.name: Pressure shifts
concepts.objective: Detect when a team's pressing intensity changes over a match, and explain likely causes.

concepts.name: Variance and results
concepts.objective: Separate performance from results, and reason about luck and sample size.

concepts.name: Control vs. chaos
concepts.objective: Judge whether a stretch of play is controlled or chaotic, describe its rhythm, and say which team it favors.
